newsitem.title: USA: Bell Microproducts sees Q2 below Q1.
newsitem.headline: Bell Microproducts sees Q2 below Q1.

text.p: Bell Microproducts Inc said that its revenues and earnings for the second quarter will be below first quarter levels of $141 million in revenue and $0.27 in earnings per share.

The company said it currently expects revenues to be slightly above the $113 million reported in the second quarter a year ago, and earnings per share to be about 10 to 15 percent below the $0.22 reported in the same period last year.
Bell said the revenue shortfall in this year's second quarter versus this year's first quarter was primarily attributable to a decline in sales of data storage products.

The profit shortfall in this year's second quarter versus this year's first quarter was primarily a result of the revenue shortfall plus increased costs associated with Quadrus, the company's contract manufacturing business.
Bell is set to announce complete second quarter financial results on July 17 after the market close.
Bell Microproducts is a distributor of high technology products serving the industrial and commercial markets.
